text:
[name]
Chicago, IL · [email] · [phone] · [url]

PROFILE
Engagement manager at McKinsey & Company after six years as a US Army infantry officer. Commanded a 130-soldier rifle company on a nine-month deployment; Bronze Star Medal. West Point graduate (top 5% of class), Harvard MBA. Lead client teams of five on operations and public-sector transformations; most recent engagement delivered about $60M of annual run-rate impact.

EXPERIENCE

McKinsey & Company — Chicago, IL
Engagement Manager | Jul 2025 – Present
- Lead teams of 4 to 6 consultants on operations and organization engagements for industrial and public-sector clients; responsible for the work plan, the client relationship at the vice-president level and the development of the team
- Led a 10-month supply-chain transformation for a $9B industrial distributor: redesigned the regional distribution network and inventory policy, delivering about $60M of annual run-rate savings (verified by the client's finance team), with 70% realized within the first year
- Managed a procurement diagnostic for a state agency with a $1.8B addressable spend base; identified $95M of savings opportunities and built the implementation office that captured the first $30M
- Rated in the top tier of engagement managers in the Chicago office in the 2025 year-end review; selected to lead the office's veteran recruiting program

Associate | Aug 2023 – Jun 2025
- Served on 6 engagements across operations, organization design and public-sector strategy
- Built the labor-planning model for a 40-site manufacturing network that cut overtime spending by 22% at the three pilot plants
- Designed the operating model and governance for a merger integration of two hospital systems (combined 11,000 employees)
- Early promotion to engagement manager after 23 months

United States Army — Infantry Officer
Captain, Company Commander, 1st Battalion, 26th Infantry Regiment, 101st Airborne Division | Fort Campbell, KY and deployed | Jun 2019 – May 2021
- Commanded a rifle company of 130 soldiers, responsible for their training, readiness, discipline and welfare, and for about $18M of vehicles, weapons and equipment
- Led the company on a nine-month deployment to Iraq in support of the advise-and-assist mission: 140 partnered operations with Iraqi security forces, zero soldiers killed or seriously injured
- Awarded the Bronze Star Medal for leadership on the deployment; the company was rated the battalion's top company in the pre-deployment collective training evaluation
- Reduced the company's vehicle non-mission-capable rate from 18% to 6% in four months by restructuring maintenance accountability
- Rated in the top 10% of captains in the brigade by the battalion and brigade commanders

Captain, Battalion Assistant Operations Officer | Jun 2018 – May 2019
- Planned and synchronized training for an 800-soldier battalion; wrote the orders for 3 brigade-level field exercises
- Managed the battalion's $2.4M annual training budget and ammunition allocation

First Lieutenant and Second Lieutenant, Rifle Platoon Leader and Executive Officer, 3rd Brigade Combat Team, 10th Mountain Division | Fort Drum, NY | Jun 2015 – May 2018
- Led a 38-soldier infantry platoon, including a nine-month deployment to Afghanistan; platoon completed 90 combat patrols with no serious casualties
- As company executive officer, managed maintenance and logistics for a 140-soldier company and passed the division's property accountability inspection with zero findings
- Ranger School graduate (2015); Air Assault and Airborne qualified

EDUCATION
Harvard Business School — Boston, MA
M.B.A., 2023; Baker Scholar (top 5% of the class); co-president, Armed Forces Alumni Association (about 200 members)

United States Military Academy at West Point — West Point, NY
B.S. in Operations Research, 2015; Distinguished Cadet (top 5% of the class, graduated 31st of 998); cadet battalion commander (one of 12, responsible for about 500 cadets); varsity wrestling, 3 years

AWARDS AND RECOGNITION
- Bronze Star Medal (2021); Meritorious Service Medal (2021); Army Commendation Medal (2); Combat Infantryman Badge
- Ranger Tab; Expert Infantryman Badge
- George C. Marshall Award nominee, 2015 (top cadet in the operations research department)

SKILLS AND OTHER
Operations and supply-chain strategy, organization design, public-sector transformation, team leadership under pressure; Excel modeling, Alteryx, Tableau; Secret clearance (inactive); Chicago Marathon finisher 2024; volunteer mentor with a veterans' career-transition nonprofit
